text: AI is changing the way we think about creativity. Today, AI tools can create art, compose music, and even write stories. Some people are amazed by this, while others feel worried. Can a machine really be creative? Supporters say AI simply helps humans come up with new ideas faster. Critics argue that real creativity comes from human emotions and experience, which machines do not have. In my opinion, AI is a useful tool, but it cannot replace the human imagination. The best results happen when people and AI work together, combining technology with our own unique ideas and feelings.
